question: Which deities are identified as part of the eight mothers group?
premises: They belong to the eight mothers.
inference: Nandinī, Nārasiṃhī, Kaumārī, and others are identified as the eight mothers.
uncertainties: only three names are listed in this verse; the full set is implied
plain_english: Nandinī, Nārasiṃhī, and Kaumārī are among the eight mothers.
